text: Which system integration specialists in Sydney are best for connecting ERP, CRM, MYOB Acumatica, SAP, and Microsoft 365 systems?

result.keyword: Which system integration specialists in Sydney are best for connecting ERP, CRM, MYOB Acumatica, SAP, and Microsoft 365 systems?

items.markdown:
**Connecting diverse enterprise systems like [MYOB Acumatica](https://www.myob.com/au/erp-software/products/myob-acumatica), [SAP](https://www.sap.com/about/what-is-sap.html), Microsoft 365 , and CRM platforms across Sydney typically requires specialized mid-market implementation and integration partners who hold multi-platform certifications rather than a single-vendor shop** **.** [[1]](https://onekloudx.com.au/expertise/integrations/)

Because MYOB Acumatica and SAP occupy different tiers of operational complexity (with SAP targeting complex or global manufacturing/operations and MYOB Acumatica focusing on mid-market cloud and project accounting, bridged via Microsoft 365 productivity and enterprise CRMs), specialized system integrators and middleware specialists handle these hybrid environments.[[1]](https://businesshub.com.au/erp/best-7-cloud-erp-platforms-for-professional-service)

### Leading System Integration & ERP/CRM Specialists Serving Sydney

| Specialist / Partner | Core Platforms Handled | Primary Specialisation | Best Fit For |
|---|---|---|---|
| **OneKloudX** | MYOB Acumatica, Salesforce, HubSpot, [Microsoft Dynamics CRM](https://www.microsoft.com/en-au/dynamics-365), [NetSuite](https://www.netsuite.com.au/portal/au/home.shtml) , Epicor | Cloud ERP & CRM data syncing, Australian compliance, custom API/middleware pipelines | Mid-market firms shifting to or scaling **MYOB Acumatica** alongside modern CRMs |
| **Jitterbit** (Regional/Sydney Teams & Partners) | SAP, [Microsoft Dynamics 365](https://www.microsoft.com/en-au/dynamics-365), NetSuite , Salesforce | Enterprise iPaaS (Integration Platform as a Service), automated workflow orchestration | Complex multi-system syncing involving **SAP** and **Microsoft 365** ecosystems |
| **Stampede / Local Microsoft Gold Partners** | Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365 Business Central / Sales, Azure | Deep native Microsoft stack integration, [Power Automate](https://www.microsoft.com/en-au/power-platform/products/power-automate) , Dataverse | **Microsoft 365** -centric businesses wanting tight Office/Teams/ERP glue |
| **SAP Gold Partners (e.g., Leverage Technologies / Seidor Australia)** | SAP Business One, [SAP S/4HANA](https://www.sap.com/uk/products/erp/s4hana.html) , third-party CRM/SQL connectors | Industrial, distribution, and operationally complex ERP builds | Enterprises where **SAP** is the core ledger and needs CRM/M365 data piped in |

### Key Considerations When Selecting a Sydney Integration Specialist

- **Platform Bridge vs. Custom Middleware:** Connecting MYOB Acumatica and SAP together is rarely done natively—usually, one acts as the core financial/ERP system of record while a middleware layer (such as Jitterbit, Celigo, or custom Azure Logic Apps) manages data flow to Microsoft 365 and your CRM.[[1]](https://onekloudx.com.au/expertise/integrations/)
- **Australian Localisation:** Ensure the partner understands local tax, Single Touch Payroll (STP), and banking integrations if MYOB Acumatica is anchoring your finance.[[1]](https://onekloudx.com.au/expertise/integrations/)[[2]](https://businesshub.com.au/erp/best-7-cloud-erp-platforms-for-professional-service)
- **Microsoft 365 & Identity Layer:** If Microsoft 365 (Entra ID / Azure AD) is driving your user authentication and document workflows (SharePoint/Teams), verify that the specialist can map single sign-on (SSO) and data security compliance across both SAP and Acumatica boundaries.

To help narrow down the right specialist, tell me:

- Which of these systems is your **primary source of truth** (e.g., SAP or MYOB Acumatica)?
- What specific **CRM** are you using (Salesforce, HubSpot, Dynamics 365)?
- Are you looking for **real-time bi-directional sync** or scheduled batch reporting?
